api.clips: Unchanged 24 emotion IDs and catalogue order.
api.variants: Separate frozen map containing curious-investigate, curious-wry, and mischievous-one-peek. These are auditions, not extra emotions.
api.performances: Frozen merged lookup for clips and variants.

fixedQuestion.intendedMeaning: Attention to a concrete question, a short reading and consideration pause, then an invitation to consider it together. The behavior claims no project success, failure, or discovered answer.

beats.intent: Gaze finds the question on the right.
Head follows; glasses support careful reading.
Gaze scans lower; a tiny hand gathers for consideration.
End of a 290 ms still consideration pause.
Return toward the visitor before the hand opens.
One small open mitten offers the question; no success prop.

variants.label: A small afterthought
variants.comparison: Numerically identical to curious-investigate through 3050 ms. The difference is confined to one brief brow, eyelid, gaze and mouth afterthought with a small mitten release.

additionalBeats.intent: Restrained side glance and lifted brow.

variants.label: One peek
variants.comparison: The standard mischievous clip retains its two-peek control. This alternative retains the same initial pretend-sleep and reveal but holds the half-open eye after one peek; it does not close and reopen for a second check.
variants.staticIntent: The selected still retains one closed eye, one half-open eye, the betrayed antenna and tucked wings. Readability is for renderer review.

standardRefinements.name: Rest entry
standardRefinements.change: Skip the redundant transition blend only when every numeric channel is exactly neutral and all inherited velocities are zero. The authored opening already begins at neutral.
standardRefinements.measuredReason: The old 380 ms blend attenuated the early antenna cue in addition to its keyframe easing. Engine output from rest now equals the authored pose at the inspected onset samples.
standardRefinements.scope: Applies consistently to all performances from exact rest; non-neutral and moving interruptions still blend.

standardRefinements.name: Curious replay
standardRefinements.change: Add Curious and its two narrative variants to a compatible transition family, retaining the actual face and posture through unassigned early channels.
standardRefinements.measuredReason: Curious replay no longer resets headX toward zero or mouth to the broad neutral welcome during its antenna-first opening.

standardRefinements.name: Surprised onset
standardRefinements.change: Face registers at 140 ms, head and mittens answer at 310 ms, wings open at 650 ms. Replace the old 320 ms preparatory dip. Use a 180 ms entry blend from grounded non-neutral poses; retain the ordinary blend when arriving from a hop.

standardRefinements.name: Excited landing follow-through
standardRefinements.change: Preserve the tested body trajectory and exact 1060 ms contact. Head reaches local Y=0 at contact, compresses to Y=4 at 1140 ms, and recovers to Y=-4 at 1410 ms. No second body bounce and no anatomical scale.

standardRefinements.name: Worried mitten separation audition
standardRefinements.change: Move the lower mitten from LY=480 to 482 and the upper mitten from RX=343/RY=454 to RX=349/RY=463. Preserve the two different hand heights and all shapes.
standardRefinements.intent: Move the upper mitten modestly away from the ruff without enlarging a hand or arm. Requires the fresh actual-size renderer comparison before claiming greater clarity.

retainedChoices: Thinking remains a deliberate chin contact with its lower free mitten; no larger arm or hand.
Focused retains two separated low mittens; its previous improvement is visible in the inspected prior sheet.
